nodes.name: Template-free solvothermal synthesis
nodes.procedure: Wang et al. employed a template-free/surfactant-free solvothermal method to simultaneously prepare WO3-x quantum dots and bundled nanowires with diameters of about 3.25 nm and 27.5 nm, respectively.

nodes.name: WCl6 concentration-controlled solvothermal
nodes.procedure: Huang et al. prepared WO3-x with three morphologies of nanowires, nanoclusters, and nanoflowers by controlling the concentration of WCl6. Sun et al. reported that lower concentrations of WCl6 help to reduce the supersaturation of the tungsten source and promote the nanowire growth of W18O49.

nodes.name: W(CO)6 ethanol solvothermal
nodes.procedure: Zhao et al. prepared W18O49 as nanofibrous flowers by mixing W(CO)6 with ethanol.

nodes.name: A-PTA solvothermal + ball milling
nodes.procedure: Park et al. prepared WO3-x nanoparticles using A-PTA as a precursor and optimized the synthesized WO3-x with smaller nano-size by wet ball milling.

nodes.name: Ammonium metatungstate muffle furnace annealing
nodes.procedure: Wu et al. obtained self-doped WO3-x thin films by using ammonium metatungstate ((NH4)6H2W12O40) as a precursor, followed by annealing in a muffle furnace. The grain size of tungsten oxide prepared by this method was mainly concentrated at 40-80 nm, while a large number of nanoscale pores were generated on the surface.

nodes.name: Hydrothermal WO3 + H2/Ar annealing
nodes.procedure: Ye et al. annealed hydrothermally prepared WO3 nanosheets in a stream of 5 vol% H2 and 95 vol% Ar at annealing temperature range of 100∼500°C. The colour changed from light yellow to dark blue with increasing annealing temperature.
nodes.source_text: Ye et al. annealed hydrothermally prepared WO3 nanosheets in a stream of 5 vol% H2 and 95 vol% Ar at an annealing temperature range of 100∼500°C...

nodes.name: Seed-mediated hydrothermal + H2 annealing
nodes.procedure: Gao et al. used a seed-mediated hydrothermal method and subsequent H2 annealing. The seed solution was obtained by mixing and dissolving 2.5 g H2WO4, 1 g PVA, and 34 ml H2O2. WO3-x nanosheets with vertical arrays on FTO-coated glass were synthesized.
nodes.source_text: Gao et al. used a seed-mediated hydrothermal method and subsequent H2 annealing... As in Fig. 2d, WO3-x nanosheets with vertical arrays on FTO-coated glass were synthesized.

nodes.name: WO3·H2O calcination in N2/air
nodes.procedure: Zhang et al. calcined the WO3·H2O nanosheets in N2 gas and air to control the Ov concentration. Li et al. annealed the prepared WO3 at 250, 350, 450 and 550°C to obtain WO3-x with different Ov concentrations.
